offline.q: Do I need internet during the show?
offline.a: No. Installed as an app, Setlyst keeps your repertoire on the device and Live Mode works without a connection. Changes made offline are sent when the network returns.

bands.q: Can I use it with my band?
bands.a: Yes. Create a band, invite the members by link and set each one's role. The band's repertoire, setlists, gigs and tours are available to everyone, according to their permissions.

content.q: Does Setlyst provide lyrics and chords?
content.a: No. You add your own repertoire, by typing or importing ChordPro files. Other artists' lyrics and chords are protected by copyright; keeping them for rehearsal and performance is the responsibility of whoever adds them.

devices.q: Which devices does it work on?
devices.a: Any current browser on a phone, tablet or computer. You can also install Setlyst as an app from the browser on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.

data.a: Your data is used only to provide the service, in line with Brazil's LGPD. You can export all your content at any time and delete your account in the settings. Details in the Privacy Policy.

free.q: Do I have to pay to use it now?
free.aPreRelease: No. During the pre-release period, every feature is available free of charge. We will give at least 30 days' notice by e-mail and in the platform before billing starts, and no plan is ever taken out or charged without your express confirmation.
free.aEnforced: Every new account gets 30 free days of the Pro plan, with no card required. After that, you choose a plan to keep the paid features.

trialEnd.q: What happens when the trial ends?
trialEnd.a: If you have not subscribed to a plan, nothing is charged: your content stays saved and your features become those of an account without a plan. If you subscribed during the trial, the first charge happens on the date shown when you subscribed, and we let you know by e-mail 7 days before.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes, in your account settings, with no fee. The plan stays active until the end of the period already paid and is not renewed. Details in the <subscription>Subscription Terms</subscription>.

withdrawal.q: How does the right of withdrawal work?
withdrawal.a: Under article 49 of the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code, you can withdraw within 7 days of subscribing (or of the first charge, if you subscribed during the trial), with the button in Settings › Subscription or by e-mail, and get a full refund of what you paid, even if you have already used the plan. Details in the <subscription>Subscription Terms</subscription>.

limits.q: What if I go over my plan's limits?
limits.a: Nothing is deleted. You keep access to everything, but you cannot create new items of that type until you are within the limit or move to a larger plan.

credits.q: What are credits and promo codes?
credits.a: Credits can be exchanged for plan days, and promo codes grant days, credits or discounts. None of them has a cash value or can be transferred to another account.

referral.q: How does the referral programme work?
referral.a: Share your referral link. When someone creates an account and confirms their e-mail address, both accounts receive credits. There is a monthly limit of rewarded referrals; the full rules are in the <subscription>Subscription Terms</subscription>.
